modules.name: Advanced setup

steps.text: Pick factions with total Reach of at least {n}
steps.note: Marquise 10, Hundreds 9, Keepers 8, Duchy 8, Lilypad 7, Eyrie 7, Vagabond 5 (second 2), Riverfolk 5, Knaves 4, Twilight 4, Alliance 3, Corvid 3, Lizard 2

steps.text: Assign factions; random starting player and seating; each takes their faction board and pieces
Bots: set up each bot as described in the Law of Rootbotics
Choose a map; variant maps (Winter, Mountain, Lake): follow its setup, then shuffle the 12 suit markers facedown onto the clearings
A ruin on each of the 4 "R" slots
Item supply at the top of the map: 2 boots, 2 bags, 1 crossbow, 1 hammer, 2 swords, 2 tea, 2 coins
Two battle dice by the map; hand out overview cards as desired
Optionally swap the shared deck for the Exiles and Partisans (or Squires and Disciples) deck
Random seating order and first player
Optional landmarks: deal 1-2, the last player(s) in turn order set them up
Optional hirelings: deal 3 and demote {n} at random; set them up counterclockwise from the last player; markers on 4, 8 and 12 of the score track
steps.note: Box any faction whose hireling is in play

steps.text: Draw {n} cards each (you keep 3 later)
Setup-card draft: 1 militant card to the pool, then 1 card per player from the rest; choose counterclockwise from the last player and set up immediately
steps.note: 2 players: no insurgent cards. A Vagabond card gets a random character; Knaves get 4 Captain cards

steps.text: Keep 3 cards, put 2 facedown on the deck, then shuffle the deck
Score markers on 0
Remove the 4 dominance cards
Shuffle the shared deck; each player draws {n}
Set up factions in setup order (A, B, C...) following each faction board's back
Set up factions in setup order (A, B, C...) following each faction board's back
Marquise de Cat
details: Scores by building workshops, sawmills and recruiters; more of one kind scores more
Needs a connected wood economy to keep building
The Keep: only she may place pieces in the keep clearing
Field Hospitals: spend a card matching the clearing to return removed warriors to the keep

steps.text: Eyrie Dynasties
details: Evening: scores by the number of roosts on the map
Must carry out every Decree action each turn or fall into turmoil
Lords of the Forest: rule a clearing when tied for most pieces
Disdain for Trade: crafted items score only 1 point

steps.text: Woodland Alliance
details: Scores when placing sympathy (10 tokens); needs supporter cards to do so
Revolts establish bases, which let them train officers
Guerrilla War: as defender deals the higher roll, the attacker the lower
Outrage: anyone removing sympathy or moving into a sympathetic clearing adds a matching card to their Supporters
Losing a base discards its supporters (birds too) and half the officers

steps.text: Vagabond
details: Scores by improving relationships, removing warriors of hostile factions and completing quests
Not a warrior: never rules a clearing; moves regardless of rule (Nimble)
Everything he can do depends on his items; explores ruins for more
4+ players: can form a coalition with the lowest-scoring player via a dominance card

steps.text: Lizard Cult
details: Acts by revealing cards, which come back in Evening unless used to score
Builds gardens where it rules; rules any clearing with a garden (Pilgrims)
Revenge: warriors removed while defending become acolytes
Spent and discarded cards go to the Lost Souls pile; birds are not wild for rituals

steps.text: Riverfolk Company
details: Scores by building trade posts and by hoarding funds
Others buy its services at the start of their Birdsong
Swimmers: treat rivers as paths, ignoring rule
Public Hand: plays with its hand face up

steps.text: Underground Duchy
details: Scores and gains resources by swaying ministers
The Burrow: an unsuited clearing next to every tunnel, always ruled by the Duchy
The Price of Failure: losing buildings returns their best minister and removes its crown

steps.text: Corvid Conspiracy
details: Scores each time a plot token flips face up; more revealed plots score more
Eight plot tokens, one per clearing; Nimble
Exposure: an enemy in the clearing may show a matching card to guess a face-down plot
Embedded Agents: +1 hit when defending with a face-down plot there

steps.text: Lord of the Hundreds
details: Evening: scores for ruled clearings with Hundreds pieces and no enemy pieces
The warlord's mood gives an ability for the turn; more items in the Hoard leave fewer moods
Mobs destroy enemy buildings and tokens; can raid ruins
Looters: as attacker, may skip rolled hits to take an item from the defender if they rule the clearing after battle (not the Vagabond)

steps.text: Keepers in Iron
details: Delve relics from forests, carry them to a matching waystation and recover them for 1-3 points
+2 points for each set of figure, tablet and jewelry
A growing Retinue gives more actions, but delving and recovering can cost the card used

steps.text: Lilypad Diaspora
details: Scores by spending cards matching Peaceful enclaves; Militant enclaves give warriors
Adds frog cards and the Pond discard pile; Swimmers
Fears Come to Pass: attacking or removing a Peaceful enclave makes enclaves Militant
Negotiations: once per turn an enemy there may flip a Militant enclave to Peaceful

steps.text: Twilight Council
details: Assemblies score, banish enemy warriors and gain loyalists (up to 4)
Evening: scores for Governing assemblies with enemy buildings or tokens
Governors: enemies cannot craft, place, remove, take or flip pieces at Governing assemblies, except in battle
Peacekeepers: defends enemies attacked at an assembly; enemies may Entreat to close an assembly

steps.text: Knaves of the Deepwood
details: Scores each turn from acclaim and from Prisoners taken in battle
Acts with one of three Captains per turn, each rested until all three have acted (Take It Easy)
Flips Stash items face down for special actions; they return when taking it easy

steps.text: First to 30 victory points wins
2 players: best played as two games, swapping factions and adding scores
Only use the river when the Riverfolk Company is in play
The starting player takes their Birdsong, Daylight and Evening
